name: partyhub
description: Plateforme de jeux multijoueurs sur navigateur (TV + smartphones)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @partyhub/shared && npm run build -w @partyhub/games && npm run build -w @partyhub/web && npm run build -w @partyhub/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @partyhub/shared && npm run build -w @partyhub/games && npm test -w @partyhub/shared && npm test -w @partyhub/games && npm test -w @partyhub/server && npm test -w @partyhub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @partyhub/shared && npm run typecheck -w @partyhub/games && npm run typecheck -w @partyhub/server && npm run typecheck -w @partyhub/web
